Kill ten Am Fah before they consume Cantha with the plague.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* You must defeat 10 more [[Am Fah]]
* See [[Imperial Agent Hanjo]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
This quest does not have a green quest marker to follow until completed. Instead, simply killing the required number of Am Fah is tallied while the quest is active.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Imperial Agent Hanjo
:''"Analysis of the chalice has lead me to a startling revelation. These Am Fah are truly monstrous individuals and may be as large a threat as the plague itself. They are fanatics who worship and embrace the effects of the plague, going so far as to purposely infect themselves with the disease. The chalice retards the sickness from advancing into its latter stages, ultimately causing the Am Fah to remain stark raving mad and highly dangerous. Because of their meddling, the plague is spreading at an alarming rate. They must be stopped! 

:''"Will you help destroy these monsters?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = The Am Fah themselves are a plague upon Cantha. Let the swift justice of death be the cure!
|decline = I'm not in a killing mood at the moment. Perhaps after supper...
|ask = Kill '''10 Am Fah''' and return to me after you have done so. 
|indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Imperial Agent Hanjo
:''Good work <Character Name>. Although there are still some Am Fah that survived, you have bought us some time and stopped the spread of the disease. Thank you for your service''

==Notes==
*You can complete this quest, [[The Xunlai Agent]], [[Eliminate the Am Fah]] or many other quests simultaneously.
*When starting [[Vizunah Square]] from the [[Vizunah Square (Local Quarter)|Local Quarter]], this quest will be completed without a fight, as [[Mhenlo]] and his party will kill enough Am Fah while making their way to your location.
